inputs.limitation: ncRNA boundaries are the source study's pre-RT-DNA bioinformatic annotation; no separate source-study supplementary file exists in this repository, so the panel is pinned as an ingested object only (R2a_PROVENANCE.md §5)
inputs.role: the ncRNA and RT-DNA sequence objects for the 81 Tier-A anchors and the pinned retron_sub stratification vocabulary; read by the §4 gate, the §4b gate and the measurement

inputs.limitation: R1b's own report carries the withdrawn cross-element 0.188/2.148 ratio summary; R2A consumes its coordinates and re-derives every ratio per element (R2_COORDINATE_FRAME_DIAGNOSIS.md)
inputs.role: the accepted T-R1b coordinate table: ncrna_start, ncrna_end, mapping_state, orientation, lengths and the propagated retron_sub. Coordinates only, no sequences

resources.note: single Python process plus one RNAfold subprocess; the two inputs total under 0.5 MB and the outputs are 81 + 162 + ~170 TSV rows. I/O is negligible, so io_tokens=1: this task can run alongside a heavy-I/O task without contending for the NVMe device WORKING_RULES §4 names as the binding constraint.

runtime.stop_note: A failed blocking check ends the task: the runner writes R2a_controls.tsv, logs/run_log.json and a TASK_STATE=STOP TASK_REPORT.md, writes NO primary table, and exits non-zero (2 at the gate stage, 5 at the output stage). WORKING_RULES §6b rule 2 then applies — escalate and open a new id, never a v2 under this identity. There is no anomaly exclusion rule: a mismatching element is a STOP, never a dropped row. resume_allowed is false and R2a_PRE_output_directory_clean fails closed, so a partial output directory cannot be silently continued or overwritten.
